title: SPA fallback condition is always-true, making the final 404 branch unreachable
detail: api/routes.ts trailing 404 guards on `!startsWith('/api/')` but /api/ returns earlier, so the catch-all is dead code. Re-reported 7 runs, never fixed.

title: Path-prefix containment checks omit the trailing separator (path traversal)
detail: `startsWith(resolvedDir)` must append `path.sep` or siblings like `outputs-evil` bypass it. Recurs across gallery/caption/upload/config variants over 5 runs.

title: handleVerifyPython forwards raw err.message / Python stderr to the client
detail: api/config.ts returns the spawn error or last stderr line to the client (path/env disclosure). Log server-side, return generic. Re-flagged 7 runs.

title: handleKnowledgeAnalyze exposes internal error message (may include API-key detail)
detail: api/knowledge.ts forwards err.message from DeepSeek/third-party calls to the client. Return generic error, log full detail server-side. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: killJob lacks a pid guard and finalizes before stream drain
detail: lib/subprocess.ts: guard `job.pid` before process.kill(); await proc.exited before finalizing so exit code/stderr drain aren't lost. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: isPathAllowed() defaults to full REPO_DIR instead of narrow output dirs
detail: caption/upload accept arbitrary client paths but allow-scope is REPO_DIR, not OUTPUT_DIRS. Narrow to the minimum dir set. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: handleClearJobs accepts arbitrary status query param without an allowlist
detail: api/jobs.ts casts `status` unchecked — a crafted value can clear running jobs without killing them. Allowlist enum (running/done/error/...). Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: HTML shell and API responses ship without baseline security headers
detail: api/routes.ts serves HTML/health without X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff etc. Add headers on shell + API responses. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: WebSocket log replay sends a LogLine object where the frontend expects a string
detail: api/ws.ts onOpen must serialize buffered {text,stream} to a string `line`; useWebSocket.ts expects a string. Type mismatch corrupts replay. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: React custom hook (useFieldHistory) called inside .map() — Rules of Hooks violation
detail: frontend/components/CommandForm.tsx calls a hook per list item, breaking hook-ordering guarantees. Hoist the hook out of the loop. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: Gallery DELETE trusts client-supplied dirIdx/name without verifying the entry was listed
detail: api/gallery.ts: path-prefix containment is not membership verification. Re-check dirIdx/name against a server-side scan before deleting. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: Cross-module singletons (subprocessManager) used without a matching import
detail: Handlers use a process/global singleton but omit its import (api/selftest.ts used subprocessManager unimported — runtime NameError). Grep usage vs imports.

title: subprocess readStream drops partial lines spanning chunk boundaries
detail: lib/subprocess.ts readStream must carry a `pending` buffer across read() chunks and flush on close, else log lines split across reads vanish.

title: FTS5 'optimize' runs even if the insert transaction throws, masking build failure
detail: lib/gallery-index.ts buildIndex: wrap the insert transaction in try/catch so one bad row doesn't silently abort the whole index while optimize still runs.

title: Bun.serve request.json() returns unknown — destructured without validation
detail: Handlers destructure body.dirIdx/body.name directly from `unknown`. Validate/cast before field access to avoid runtime type errors.

title: useLoras clears _fetching before setting _cache on the success path (cache race)
detail: frontend/hooks/useLoras.ts: ordering lets concurrent callers re-fetch. Set the cache before clearing the fetching flag.

title: useDefaultState lists serverDefaults object identity in deps, re-merging unnecessarily
detail: frontend/hooks/useDefaultState.ts: an object identity in a useEffect dep array triggers re-merge on every render. Depend on primitive fields instead.

title: handlePutConfig accepts arbitrary outputDir/modelsDir without path-containment validation
detail: api/config.ts write-time path is not bounded — a client can point generation at any directory. Validate against an allowlist at write time.

title: CSRF/origin check compares against the request's own Host header (DNS-rebinding bypass)
detail: api/routes.ts origin allowlist must be a fixed list, not derived from Host — an attacker-controlled Host defeats the check.

title: Upload/gallery serves files without Content-Type + nosniff (stored XSS via polyglot/SVG/HTML)
detail: api/gallery.ts + api/upload.ts: extension-only upload check + missing nosniff lets a polyglot payload execute. Sniff content and set headers.

title: Upload file-size check runs after the full multipart body is parsed into memory
detail: api/upload.ts: reject oversized uploads during streaming, not after — else a large body is buffered entirely (DoS).

title: File-path string fields passed to the subprocess skip path-containment checks
detail: lib/args.ts forwards path fields to run.py without containment; apply the same boundary as the API layer. (Distinct from the startsWith-separator bug.)

title: Persistent hotspots: api/routes.ts, api/gallery.ts, api/config.ts, lib/subprocess.ts, api/caption.ts, api/jobs.ts
detail: Across 8 runs these files attract the most findings. Weight attention here on incremental reviews; path-traversal/error-leak classes keep regressing here.

title: All 8 runs were effort:low review-only — zero fixes applied, zero adversarial verdicts
detail: Never run at effort:medium+fix in this history, so recurring findings stayed unfixed. To close them run medium/high with fix:true (clean tree required).

title: Findings skew to correctness (4.25/run) and security (4.5/run); other dims near zero
detail: error-handling/type-safety/code-quality avg ~0.25/run — reflection marks them reduce_effort. Focus on correctness+security; sparse dims are low-yield.

title: Top recurring findings have FP-rate 0 — re-report them, do not suppress as noise
detail: Reflection: correctness/security avg_fp_rate=0 across 8 runs. SPA-404, path-traversal and error-leak findings are real, unfixed defects that re-surface.
